payload.title: Thu 11/19: Virtual across Texas, on your calendar
payload.purpose: The virtual option for someone who travels for work or lives outside San Antonio.

captions.LI: Your patients who travel for work or live outside San Antonio can attend the Bariatric Counseling Center virtually across Texas. The same intensive outpatient program, behavioral therapy, dietary guidance, cooking classes, and mindful movement, delivered through Zoom sessions scheduled around work commitments. Patients typically attend for little to no cost under their mental health benefits. Our Director of Admissions is Leloni Gonzales (lgonzales@bccsanantonio.com and 210-634-2200). #BehavioralHealth

YT.title: Virtual Bariatric Counseling Across Texas | BCC
YT.description: The Bariatric Counseling Center offers virtual intensive outpatient programming across Texas for patients who travel for work or live outside San Antonio. The same comprehensive behavioral healthcare for obesity, therapy, dietary guidance, cooking classes, and movement education, delivered through Zoom and scheduled around your commitments. Covered by most health insurances under mental health benefits. Contact Leloni Gonzales at lgonzales@bccsanantonio.com or 210-634-2200.

payload.alt_text: Text graphic promoting virtual attendance option for the Bariatric Counseling Center's intensive outpatient program across Texas.
payload.why_now: This week highlights accessibility for traveling professionals and patients outside the San Antonio area who need behavioral obesity treatment.
